sources.title: 名古屋市総合計画2028
sources.review_boundary: The current five-year comprehensive plan and its 2040 outlook are verified. Individual indicators, target values, projects, and page-level evidence remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 名古屋市総合計画2028（42施策・506掲載事業）
sources.review_boundary: Nagoya embeds the implementation layer in the comprehensive plan through 42 measures and 506 listed projects rather than a separately verified citywide implementation-plan landing. Project identity, cost, owner, and annual execution remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 名古屋市総合計画2028進行管理（令和6年度）
sources.review_boundary: The citywide progress report covers 42 measures, 135 plan indicators, and 506 listed projects. Reported achievement or progress classifications are source statements and are not promoted to Jichi Insight policy-achievement judgments.

sources.title: 令和8年度名古屋市各会計予算（修正後）
sources.review_boundary: The enacted fiscal 2026 budget landing is verified after the council amendment. General, special, and public-enterprise accounts remain separate, and amended amounts are not linked to policy outcomes without record-level review.

sources.title: 令和6年度名古屋市各会計歳入歳出決算及び基金運用状況審査意見書
sources.review_boundary: The official all-account settlement review landing is verified. Audit conclusions, account totals, fund operations, public-enterprise accounts, projects, and policy outcomes remain separate evidence roles until reviewed linkage.

quality_boundary: This inventory confirms Nagoya City's official current-plan, embedded implementation, annual progress, enacted budget, and settlement-review entry points only. It does not convert source-reported achievement classes, project progress, budget values, settlement values, audit conclusions, or narrative outcomes into Reviewed evidence, causal attribution, cross-city comparability, or Jichi Insight policy-achievement judgments.
next_action: Review the 42 measures, 135 indicators, and 506 listed projects at record level; preserve the embedded implementation structure instead of inventing a separate plan; connect fiscal 2026 budget and fiscal 2024 settlement evidence only where project identity, period, account, unit, and responsibility are verified.
